learningObjective: Understand TVM BYOC / extern-op integration for external libraries.

canonicalClaims.claim: TVM's BYOC and extern-op mechanisms lower a Relax op or subgraph to an opaque call into a third-party library. The compiler tracks shapes/dtypes at the graph level but does not see internal loops, so the call is a black box to TensorIR-level fusion and scheduling.
conditions: Target library is registered as a BYOC backend.
nonImplications: Does not imply the library will always outperform generated code.
Does not imply BYOC and PrimFunc paths are mutually exclusive in one program.

misconceptions.claim: External library calls are inlined into TensorIR at compile time.
misconceptions.whyWrong: They remain opaque; TVM does not have their source.

misconceptions.claim: TVM cannot invoke external libraries from compiled artifacts.
misconceptions.whyWrong: BYOC supports library calls with runtime linkage.
cuBLAS/cuDNN/TensorRT are among the primary BYOC targets.

misconceptions.claim: External calls are automatically fused with adjacent PrimFuncs.
misconceptions.whyWrong: Only limited epilogue-style linking is possible; general fusion requires visible loop bodies.

implementationFacts: BYOC backends: TensorRT, cuBLAS, cuDNN, DNNL/oneAPI, etc.
Extern ops carry shape/dtype metadata for graph-level verification.
